data.name: TagFormatHelpBasic
data.value: Format syntax: [tag_part:modifier.precision] - :r = Raw (no commas) - :c = Compact units - :k/:m = Kilo/Mega units - .N = Decimals Example: [dps:c.1] -> 12.3K

data.name: TagFormatHelpComponent
data.value:
Format syntax: [tag_part:modifier.precision] - :r = Raw (no commas) - :c = Compact units - :k/:m = Kilo/Mega units - .N = Decimals or text length - _first/_last = Name parts - _skill/_val = Action name/value of the strongest hit
Example: [name_first.1].:[dps:c.1] -> J.:12.3K
